selection: Among candidates meeting the regret bound, maximize retrieval/answer latency savings vs always-hybrid minus measured routing overhead; then macro-F1; then rule, knn, logistic, llm; then lower tau. If none meet the bound, do not freeze.
oracle: Per-question maximum correct answer over three forced routes; choose minimum clean measured latency among correct routes; exact ties use graph, vector, hybrid. No-correct-route questions have null oracle_route and still contribute zero oracle accuracy.
fallback: Escalate an empty/invalid graph result or empty/low-score vector result to hybrid; log the executed route. Offline latency charges the failed initial retrieval plus hybrid, conservatively.
interpretation: Internal tuning cross-validation, not held-out paper results. One measured outcome per forced route; latency selection is provisional unless all required clean timings exist. No random seed guarantees LLM determinism.
